title: Second Vaccinations
desc: At three months old, you faced your second round of vaccinations like the little warrior you are. These tiny jabs are our way of wrapping you in a shield of protection, even when it hurts for a moment.
story: We pulled up to the clinic on a cool morning, you bundled in your pram, completely unaware of what was coming. The nurse was gentle and quick, but that didn't stop you from letting out the most heartbreaking cry the moment the first needle went in. Rotavirus, DTaP-IPV-Hep B/Hib, and MenB, three vaccinations in one sitting, and you powered through every single one. I held your tiny hand and whispered to you the whole time, telling you how sorry I was and how proud I was in the same breath. The moment it was over, you looked up at me with those watery eyes, and somehow that hit harder than any cry could. We stayed a little while after, just the two of us, you snuggled against my chest while your breathing slowly settled back to calm. That evening you were fussier than usual, and I stayed close, because after everything you went through today, the least I could do was be right there beside you.
